subject: Helix connector: SDK churn mitigation & short-term shim plan
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@helix-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: integrations@helix-analytics.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Heads-up: upcoming SDK changes affecting Helix connector

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from the Helix integration team: our engineering partner is planning an SDK release schedule change that will deprecate the legacy streaming hooks your current connector relies on (the "stream-v1" endpoints). We heard from our engineering outreach that Redwood's hosted API will move to a new streaming contract in June, and we need to understand compatibility timelines and any migration guidance you can offer.

Can you help with:

- The compatibility window you expect for stream-v1 (how long will it remain supported).
- Any short-term shims or config flags that will let us continue to operate while we update our adapter.
- Contact for a technical sync this week.

Samir
Samir Kapoor
Head of Integrations
Helix Analytics

Attachment: expected_release_notes.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@helix-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Heads-up: upcoming SDK changes affecting Helix connector

Samir — thanks for the heads-up and for flagging this early.

Short answer up front: we plan a soft-deprecation for stream-v1 and expect it to be supported for at least 90 days after the public announcement, with a recommended migration path to the new streaming contract (stream-v2) that includes protocol-level flow-control and chunked-delivery semantics. That said, we can offer a short-term shim on Redwood Dedicated and Hosted tiers for strategic partners while you migrate.

Proposed next steps:

1) Tech sync this Wednesday at 9am PT with Karthik and Vanessa on our side to walk through the protocol diffs and a compatibility matrix.
2) We'll share a compatibility_matrix_v1.xlsx and a short proposal for a shim approach (configurable proxy + header flag) before the call.
3) Agree on a mutual action plan and candidate migration dates — we'll be flexible on a per-account timeline for Helix.

Karthik — can you prepare a one-page shim proposal and the compatibility matrix? Vanessa — please loop in Partner Ops if we need contract/credits for expedited support.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@helix-analytics.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Heads-up: upcoming SDK changes affecting Helix connector — compatibility matrix and shim proposal

Hi Samir,

Thanks for the sync earlier. Attached are two artifacts I promised:
- compatibility_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet that maps stream-v1 behaviors to stream-v2 equivalents and notes where we need adapter-side changes)
- redwood-shim-proposal.md (short proposal for a lightweight proxy shim that translates stream-v1 calls to stream-v2 while preserving backwards semantics)

Key implementation notes (high level):
- Shim will handle session affinity, translate flow-control headers, and buffer small chunks for chunked-delivery semantics.
- Expected performance impact: 5–12% p90 latency increase on short-running sessions under the shim; we can measure in a staging tenant.
- Migration checklist for Helix: (a) switch to stream-v2 SDK in dev; (b) validate chunk-ordering and stop bits; (c) enable shim in prod for 60 days; (d) decommission stream-v1 client usage.

If you want, we can stand up a temporary staging endpoint for you to test. What time next week works for a joint test plan run?

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: compatibility_matrix_v1.xlsx (attachment), redwood-shim-proposal.md (attachment)
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@helix-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: integrations@helix-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Heads-up: upcoming SDK changes affecting Helix connector — compatibility matrix and shim proposal

Jordan/Karthik — appreciate the thorough proposal and fast turnaround.

Helix accepts the 90-day soft-deprecation and would like to take the shim for a spin in staging next Tuesday (26 May). Two asks before then:

1) Can you provision a staging tenant and a temporary API key scoped to the shim evaluation? We need it by EOD Friday (21 May).
2) Will Redwood provide a short runbook for rollback and for mapping observability metrics we should watch during the test (error rates, rebuffer events, latency p95)?

I'll loop in our engineering lead to coordinate test times once the environment is ready.

Thanks — excited to keep this integration healthy.

Samir Kapoor
Head of Integrations
Helix Analytics
